legacyAdapters.name: LegacyTermDictionaryAdapter
legacyAdapters.allowed: May translate legacy projection text until Language Kernel catalogs are wired into runtime.
legacyAdapters.forbidden: Must not become a new source of business facts, action definitions, or search admission.
legacyAdapters.removalCondition: All runtime projection text and search synonyms are generated from Language Kernel catalogs.

legacyAdapters.name: LegacySurfaceCopyAdapter
legacyAdapters.allowed: May render existing shell and operation copy while catalogs are adopted.
legacyAdapters.forbidden: Must not define new architecture, admission, definition, or search rules.
legacyAdapters.removalCondition: Surface copy catalog becomes the generated source for mobile and PC copy.

invariants: Frontend and backend supportedLanguages must match this contract.
Error code copy must include zh-CN, ru-RU, and ky-KG.
High-risk business reasons must include zh-CN, ru-RU, and ky-KG.
Field labels must include zh-CN, ru-RU, and ky-KG.
Search synonyms must include zh-CN, ru-RU, and ky-KG.
Language catalogs do not grant visibleAllowed, confirmAllowed, or productionAllowed.
